=== enum-as-exact-nontype-template-arg ===
$ POST https://godbolt.org/api/compiler/g132/compile

template<typename T, T val> struct integral_constant { static const T value = val; };
enum class ENUM : unsigned { TRUE_ = 0 };
typedef integral_constant<ENUM, ENUM::TRUE_> test_t;
int main(){ return (int)test_t::value; }
